# Account opening and closure
## Opening an account
A current account can be opened online with valid photo identification and proof of address. The account is ready within one working day.
## Closing an account
To close an account, clear any overdraft, cancel standing orders and send a signed closure request. The remaining balance is transferred to your nominated account.
## Joint accounts
A joint holder can be added with the consent of all existing holders and identification of the new holder.
